title: fix(storage): S3 chunked uploads resolve their object key from the upload session row
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9XSBUAWKhacmmrYT4zZC5MZ)_
Fixes #31607

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:S3 分片上传的分片门与完成门在调用后端前，从持久的 `sys_upload_session.key` 取对象 key 交给适配器;可替换存储代理补上 `setUploadKey` 转发。
- 为什么改:经代理时适配器的进程内 uploadId→key 表从未被填，单副本上第 0 片就 500;这张表只在一个进程里，换副本必然找不到。
- 风险与回滚：只动 S3 适配器经过的路径;本地适配器与无 `setUploadKey` 的适配器调用不变(各一个 pin)。回滚即 revert 本 PR,无数据迁移。
- 先看:`storage-routes.ts`(`handUploadKeyToBackend` 及分片门、完成门两处调用)、`swappable-storage-service.ts`(`setUploadKey` 转发)、新测试 `s3-chunked-upload-session-key.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-storage exec vitest run src/s3-chunked-upload-session-key.test.ts`,预期 4/4 通过;在 main 上同一文件两个 S3 用例 500 失败。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `storage-routes.ts`: a new module helper `handUploadKeyToBackend(storage, uploadId, key)` hands the backend the object key of a chunked upload. The chunk door and the completion door call it with `session.key` (the `sys_upload_session` row each door already reads) right before `uploadChunk` / `completeChunkedUpload`. The init door no longer calls `setUploadKey` itself: every backend call that names the upload now gets the key from the row, on whichever process serves it.
- `swappable-storage-service.ts`: the proxy forwards `setUploadKey` to the active adapter, and is a no-op for an adapter without it (same pattern as the proxy's existing `verifyToken` and `getPresignedUploadOrigin` passthroughs). This is what made chunk 0 fail on a single replica: the kernel's `storage` service is the proxy, and the init door's `'setUploadKey' in storage` probe never matched it.
- `s3-storage-adapter.ts`, `attachment-lifecycle.ts`: comments only. They described the map as filled once by the plugin, and said the proxy does not forward `setUploadKey`. Both were made false by this change. No code change in either file.
- `.changeset/31607-s3-chunked-upload-session-key.md`: `@objectstack/service-storage` patch.

No change to the `IStorageService` contract (`packages/spec`), to the chunked-upload HTTP requests or answers, to `sys_upload_session` (it already stores `key`, a required field), or to the local adapter (it records the key beside its parts at initiation).

Why the row, not a new key-taking method on the adapter: the card prefers the durable row, and the row already holds the key, so no column is added. Handing it down through the existing `setUploadKey` keeps a single way to address an upload on the adapter; the upload-session reap guard already re-seeds the same map from the same row before an abort, so the chunk and completion doors now follow that precedent. No new public name is introduced on the package entry; the proxy gains one method that the S3 adapter already had.

## Tests

New file `packages/services/service-storage/src/s3-chunked-upload-session-key.test.ts` (4 cases). It drives the real doors (`registerStorageRoutes`) through `SwappableStorageService`, the way `StorageServicePlugin` composes them, against an S3-compatible stand-in. Like S3, the stand-in refuses a part, completion or abort addressed to an UploadId under a different key (`NoSuchUpload`).

- `completes on a single replica`: init, chunk 0, chunk 1 and completion through one proxy and one S3 adapter; the bucket holds the whole file and no multipart is left open.
- `resumes on a fresh adapter instance: another process finds the key in the session row`: three replicas (separate adapter instances behind separate proxies) share one metadata store and one bucket. Init runs on A, chunk 0 on B, chunk 1 and completion on C. The object lands under the session row's key and the file row is `committed`.
- `local: the assembled file holds the bytes sent, across two adapter instances on one root`: unchanged behaviour for the local adapter.
- `an adapter with no setUploadKey receives exactly the contract calls, with the arguments it did before`: an in-memory adapter double sees the same four calls with the same arguments as on `main`.

A new file, not a new `describe` in an existing harness: the S3 stand-in is a `vi.mock` of `@aws-sdk/client-s3`, which is file-scoped, and no existing file mocks S3 and mounts the routes together. No existing test was changed.

<details><summary>Step 0: the defect on main (5d1382a5), new file against the unfixed code</summary>

```
[5xx] 500 — S3StorageAdapter: key not found for uploadId. Call setUploadKey() before uploadChunk().
     × completes on a single replica
     × resumes on a fresh adapter instance: another process finds the key in the session row
AssertionError: {"success":false,"error":{"code":"INTERNAL","message":"Internal error"}}: expected 500 to be 200
      Tests  2 failed | 2 passed (4)
```

`sys_upload_session` fields written by the init door: `id` (= the backend UploadId when the backend initiated), `file_id`, `key` (required), `filename`, `mime_type`, `total_size`, `chunk_size`, `total_chunks`, `resume_token`, `backend_upload_id`, `scope`, `bucket`, `metadata`, `status`, `expires_at`; the chunk door adds `parts`, `uploaded_chunks`, `uploaded_size`. The object key is present, so no column is needed.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restore proven blob == HEAD and git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

The test imports `./storage-routes.js` and `./swappable-storage-service.js` relatively, so vitest runs `src`; no `dist` leg applies.

1. Back to the in-process table: the init door seeds the map once through the proxy (`ABLATION-INIT-SEED`, count 1) and the chunk and completion doors no longer hand down the row's key (`ABLATION-NO-ROW-KEY`, count 2, anchor 2 → 0). Only the second-process case goes red, with the original error:
   ```
   [5xx] 500 — S3StorageAdapter: key not found for uploadId. Call setUploadKey() before uploadChunk().
        × resumes on a fresh adapter instance: another process finds the key in the session row
         Tests  1 failed | 3 passed (4)
   ablation-replace: ok restored: blob == HEAD (8e21af92d37b) and `git diff HEAD` is empty
   ```
2. The proxy drops the key (`ABLATION-PROXY-DROPS-KEY`, anchor 1 → 0). Both S3 cases go red:
   ```
        × completes on a single replica
        × resumes on a fresh adapter instance: another process finds the key in the session row
         Tests  2 failed | 2 passed (4)
   ablation-replace: ok restored: blob == HEAD (a5b6010fb8eb) and `git diff HEAD` is empty
   ```
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The S3 adapter's map still gains an entry on every process that serves a chunk, and only the process that completes or aborts the upload deletes its entry. An upload abandoned before completion already left its entry behind on `main`. The entries are small and are not a record anything trusts, since the row is the record. Noted, not filed.
- The upload-session reap guard (`createUploadSessionReapGuard`) still reaches the inner adapter through `getInner()` to seed the key before an abort. That still works, and the proxy now forwards the call too. It was left as is so that its tests are not changed.

## Verification

All on head `14e4eea9`.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-storage build && … test && … typecheck` under the lock: VERDICT command-exit 0; Test Files 76 passed (76), Tests 1428 passed (1428); `check:test-typecheck` OK.

- Derived gate families: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` listed 73; all 73 ran after `turbo run build --filter='./packages/**' --filter='./examples/**'` (VERDICT command-exit 0), every one exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation: 73 derived, 73 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- Dogfood, targeted (no `!` in the title, no `(narrowing)` arm, so the full battery is CI's): `storage-chunked-parallel-parts`, `storage-chunked-resume-integrity`, `attachments-permission-matrix`, `error-sentences-live` under the lock: VERDICT command-exit 0; Test Files 4 passed (4), Tests 37 passed, 1 skipped (38). These run the local adapter, so they show the local path unchanged; the S3 path is covered by the new unit file.
- `origin/main` moved 12 commits past the base `5d1382a5`; none touches `packages/services/service-storage`, so no merge was taken.
